title.narrative: Global Procurement Initiative: Procurement Assistance Program for Jamaica, through Meridian International Center

description.narrative: This Global Procurement Initiative (GPI): Procurement Assistance Program for Jamaica: Phases I and II, Training Webinars, and Virtual Roundtable is a national-level Program that encompasses four separate training components: 1) a three-day GPI Workshop in Kingston, Jamaica for about 60 government procurement officials and up to 15 observers in Spring 2019; 2a) a Value-Based Procurement Study Tour for two distinct cohorts of 15 senior Jamaican federal procurement officials, totaling 30 delegates overall, in Spring and Summer 2020; 3) three training webinars led by the GPI's technical experts between components to increase collaboration and knowledge sharing; and, 4) a virtual Workshop and Study Tour Roundtable and Panel Event (Roundtable) for all Jamaican procurement officials trained through the GPI to discuss their success, challenges, and strategies, as well as evaluate areas for further collaboration under the program. The components would be carried out in collaboration with Government of Jamaica (GOJ) Office of Public Procurement (OPP), the George Washington University Law School's Government Procurement Law Program (GW), and USTDA's GPI technical specialists.
